name: Make It Click
tagline: Explains new material by building on knowledge you already have
description: A study companion that begins with the knowledge you already hold rather than a textbook chapter. Give it a subject and it builds the explanation out of ideas you are comfortable with, so each new concept has something to attach to. Aimed at anyone who bounced off a topic once and wants it to land this time.
author: lenabuyan
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
